principles.RR01: Bind one ticker, sector, assessment period and information cutoff.
principles.RR02: Freeze exact retained source identities and temporal eligibility before analysis.
principles.RR03: Keep facts, calculated observations and analyst estimates distinct.
principles.RR04: Historical facts require correct source, definition, unit, scope and lineage.
principles.RR06: Analysts construct a quantitative model before requesting review.
principles.RR07: Use factual anchors and explain derivation, alternatives, adverse evidence and limits.
principles.RR08: Exact external numerical confirmation is optional.
principles.RR10: Use relevant external support when available under RV02.
principles.RR11: Require economic and internal consistency under RV03 and RV04.
principles.RR12: Review conservatism, coherent scenarios and counterevidence under RV05 and RV06.
principles.RR13: Persist distinct proposal and challenge steps and bind review to the exact proposal.
principles.RR14: Classify material rejection RB01–RB05; require economic rationale and affected dependency.
principles.RR15: Allow accepted estimates with explicit model-specific limitations and lineage.
principles.RR16: Allow at most one revision before final disposition.
principles.RR17: Preserve sector-compatible Method B priority, independent rubrics, bands and Method A ceilings.
principles.RR18: Preserve bounded IRR, investor entitlement, zero-dividend credit and no-rerating checks.
principles.RR19: Recalculate against eligible price, review material changes, and preserve confidence and Effective Score lineage.
principles.RR20: Preserve risk, formal authority and production restrictions; stop after bounded research.
